```artifact
Feature: System Availability and Backup

  Scenario: High Availability
    Given the system is running normally
    When the outage window of 10 minutes every 2nd Sunday is triggered
    Then the system is available for 99.999% of the time

  Scenario: System Backup
    Given the system is running normally
    When the backup cycle of 30 days is triggered
    Then the system data is backed up successfully

  Scenario: Rollback Provision
    Given the system is running normally
    When the rollback period of 1 month is triggered
    Then the system can be rolled back to the previous month's data

  Scenario: Dummy Production System Restore
    Given the system is running normally
    When the backup is restored on a dummy production system every day
    Then the backup is restored successfully

  Scenario: Dummy Production Database Purge
    Given the system is running normally
    When the dummy production database is purged after backup
    Then the database is purged successfully

  Scenario: Data Storage Compliance
    Given the system is running normally
    When the data is stored in Mangalore HQ in a fireproof cabinet 25 KM away from the Hospital
    Then the data is stored in compliance with health care regulations as defined by Government of India

  Scenario Outline: Availability Boundary Values
    Given the system is running normally
    When the outage window of <time> minutes every <day> is triggered
    Then the system is available for <availability>%
    Examples:
      | time | day | availability |
      | 5    | 1   | 99.99%       |
      | 10   | 2   | 99.999%      |
      | 15   | 3   | 99.99%       |

  Scenario Outline: Backup Cycle Boundary Values
    Given the system is running normally
    When the backup cycle of <days> days is triggered
    Then the system data is backed up successfully
    Examples:
      | days |
      | 15   |
      | 30   |
      | 45   |

  Scenario Outline: Rollback Period Boundary Values
    Given the system is running normally
    When the rollback period of <days> days is triggered
    Then the system can be rolled back to the previous month's data
    Examples:
      | days |
      | 15   |
      | 30   |
      | 45   |

  Scenario Outline: Distance Boundary Values
    Given the system is running normally
    When the data is stored in Mangalore HQ in a fireproof cabinet <distance> KM away from the Hospital
    Then the data is stored in compliance with health care regulations as defined by Government of India
    Examples:
      | distance |
      | 20       |
      | 25       |
      | 30       |

  Scenario: Compliance Verification
    Given the system is running normally
    When the system is designed to comply with health care regulations as defined by Government of India
    Then the system is compliant with health care regulations
```
